body:
The stamp of refusal on the request slip made my heart sink, but there was an undeniable sense of protectiveness deep inside me. I felt compelled to shield them from any unnecessary distress. My eyes scanned the room for familiar faces, seeking someone who might understand or offer comfort. As I approached the nearest person, their voice came out hoarse and tired, but they recognized my urgency.

"You can't just let this go, can you?" They murmured urgently, their fingers trembling slightly as they held onto something—likely a piece of paper with more details.

I nodded, pulling away the layers of formalities and personal papers until we were face-to-face. "We need to talk," I said softly, knowing every second counted.
